standardisation: For EACH (stage,observable) column separately across available models: z=(difference-mean_column)/sample_std_column; ddof=1
zero_variance_policy: Set available z-scores to 0; flag column in CSV
scope: EFT1 E+W OFF is LLSS approximation, not complete EFT1 freeze
note: A z-score of zero means the column average, NOT zero running effect. This is a between-model standardisation, NOT NuFIT significance.
